subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase.

Those who have died cannot be __brought back to life__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Resurrect**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Resurrect"** means to bring someone back to life or revive something that has been inactive or forgotten. (पुनर्जीवित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The scientist in the movie tried to resurrect the ancient creature from its remains.
 
 
 
• The phrase **"Those who have died cannot be brought back to life"** refers to the act of attempting to restore life, which directly aligns with the meaning of "resurrect." (पुनर्जीवन का प्रयास)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Resurrect**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Retract** (वापस लेना): To withdraw a statement, accusation, or commitment.

 
 
• **Example:** The journalist had to retract the statement after it was proven false.
 
 
 
• **Abstract** (सार): Existing in thought or as an idea but not having a physical or concrete existence.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist painted an abstract piece that left the audience interpreting its meaning.
 
 
 
• **Extract** (निचोड़ना): To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.
 
 
• **Example:** The dentist had to extract the decayed tooth carefully.
